# Security and privacy

- Never put real customer, account, credential, or credit-report data in source control, fixtures, logs, or screenshots.
- Use only obviously fictional names, `.test` email addresses, and fabricated identifiers in seeds and examples.
- Require explicit applicable consent and a valid purpose before any future bureau-data access.
- Do not expose secrets in frontend code or commit them to the repository.
- Treat authorization, data minimization, auditability, and human review as design requirements; a prototype is not a compliance certification.
